marie (ops): Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands on the incident and reliability roadmap. Recording + slides: https://redwood.company/allhands/1950001234 :point_down:
marie (ops): RCA doc is here: https://internal.redwood/rcas/INC-2026-07 - please read the summary and confirm owners on the tracker. :spiral_note_pad:
kevin (sre): I've taken the KV-cache eviction tuning action (jen/kevin). Will push a rollout plan by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
maya (eng-runtime): For the kernel patch rollout, are we targeting Dedicated first or both Dedicated + Hosted? Need to know for perf validation matrix.
samir (vp-eng): Prioritize Dedicated for the canary, then Hosted region-by-region. We want safety before wide rollout. Maya, sync with kevin on perf tests.
jen (reliability): Added a short action table to the tracker:
```
- INC-2026-07: root-cause analysis (doc link)
- A1: KV-cache tuning --- owner: kevin --- ETA: 2026-03-25
- A2: Kernel patch rollout plan --- owner: maya --- ETA: 2026-04-01
- A3: SLA runbook updates --- owner: alejandro --- ETA: 2026-03-28
- A4: Postmortem blameless review --- owner: marie --- ETA: 2026-03-27
```
alejandro (product): I'll take SLA runbook updates. Can someone paste the current SLO numbers in the tracker so I have the source of truth?
marie (ops): pasted SLOs into tracker now: https://internal.redwood/trackers/rca-1950001234 - check the "SLOs" tab.
kevin (sre): quick note: perf tests need a small infra change (extra GPU in the canary pool). I'll open infra-req ticket and tag eng-infra.
incidents-bot: Incident timeline posted: https://internal.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-07/timeline :information_source:
samir (vp-eng): Two asks for leads: 1) confirm owners in the tracker by EOD today, 2) flag any blockers (permits, infra) in-thread so we can escalate.
maya (eng-runtime): Confirmed owner and will start test plan tomorrow. Tagging kevin for infra ticket once available. :rocket:
jen (reliability): I'll coordinate the blameless review session — proposing 2026-03-30 10:00am PT. Please add availability to the calendar invite when you can.
marie (ops): Thanks — I'll collect acknowledgements and post a consolidated status by tomorrow morning. :eyes:
kevin (sre): acked.
alejandro (product): acked.
samir (vp-eng): acked.
maya (eng-runtime): acked.
jen (reliability): acked.
marie (ops): If anyone hits a blocker for their action, reply here and I'll reroute. Otherwise we'll treat this as the canonical post-all-hands action thread. :white_check_mark:
